justification: This case concerns primarily Article 3 (torture/ill-treatment) complaints; while two applicants (nos. 23922/20 and 53881/20) have Article 11 complaints listed in the appendix as 'other complaints under well-established case-law,' the Court does not conduct any standalone Article 11 merits analysis — the Article 11 findings are subsumed within a brief reference to well-established case-law without a genuine, coherent Article 11 merits adjudication.
